title: Customers who bought electronics
statementMd:
List the names of customers who have ordered at least one Electronics product (any status).

Expected columns: `name`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT c.name FROM customers c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND p.category = 'Electronics');
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
